headline: Youth sports presentations, Nipper Maher Park signage and lights, and the Lawrence School Building are on the agenda.
summary: The board will hear presentations from Waltham Youth Baseball and Waltham Girls Softball, discuss historical signage and lights for Nipper Maher Park, and review the Lawrence School Building with Mayor McCarthy. Monthly bills, statement of accounts, and the Director's Report will also be covered.
